quick_check.question: In the final tree, delete 20. Which key replaces it, and is the node easy to remove?
quick_check.answer: Nothing replaces it: 20 has only a left child, 19, so 19 is spliced into 20's place.
quick_check.note: One-child deletion changes a pointer, not a key
